args.body: Dear landlord, thank you for your email about Flat 12, 162 Beacon Close. Sorry: our earlier summary said no issues, but the report does note a dog flap (utility room/back door) and a small marked patch on a Bedroom 1 wall, which the tenant is to make good. Dog flap: we have no record of your consent on file. We are asking the tenant whether permission was given, and will report back. Please tell us whether you want it kept, or removed and made good. Lock change: our record shows no lock change and no spare key. We are asking the tenant who changed it and when, and to get a copy of the new key to us. Could you confirm who changed the lock, if you know? Your email is signed Felix Clarke, but our record names Oliver Bennett. Please confirm who you are. We will update you by 2024-02-21.
